title: Command & Conquer Generals Zero Hour
provenance: Reported by KujaxG (highball#298, 2026-10-09), Apple M2 Pro, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.10. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: The game stopped with a message that it needs DirectX 8 or later. Generals shows that when it cannot use the screen resolution it picked, and Mac screens have sizes it does not expect. Setting Resolution = 1280 720 in Options.ini (Documents, Command and Conquer Generals Zero Hour Data, create the file with that line if it is missing) is the usual fix, and Emulate display mode changes on the game's page can help. GenLauncher, a mod installer, runs as a Windows program in the game's environment. Not confirmed by the reporter.

knownIssues.symptom: 'DirectX 8 or later required' at start (reported on an M2 Pro, macOS 27.0.1)
knownIssues.cause: the game cannot use the resolution it picked on a Mac screen
